title: Brighton Storm Villa 4‑0 – Betting Insights for African Punters
flags: The result, confirmed by *Punch Sports* on Sunday, 23 August 2026
Marcus Tavernier opened the scoring, and the Seagulls added three more in the second half, with goals from Marc Guehi, Josko Gvardiol and a late strike that sealed the victory.
The scoreline was a shock to many, especially considering Villa’s recent form in the Premier League and the fact that Brighton were only a few points above the relegation zone before the season.

Enzo Maresca’s First Premier League Win

In another Premier League match, Manchester City edged Bournemouth 2‑1, giving first‑time manager Enzo Maresca his inaugural win. The victory, reported by *Independent Football*, will influence the “Man City win” market for the upcoming fixtures. A win for City adds momentum to their title‑challenging campaign, and African bettors often see the odds for City to win move closer to 1.20‑1.30 after a high‑profile victory.
